defects.description: Monthly/yearly billing toggle is present but placed at the bottom-left corner of the canvas instead of 'at the top of the page' as explicitly requested. The toggle appears to be floating or misplaced, partially cut off and overlapping the footer area.

Severe vertical spacing issue: excessive whitespace between the header/navigation and the 'Simple, transparent pricing' headline, creating a disconnected, floating appearance. The headline feels orphaned with too much empty space above the pricing cards.
defects.location: Between navigation bar and hero headline

defects.description: The hero headline 'Simple, transparent pricing' and subheadline use an extremely light gray/white that blends into the white background, creating illegible text with insufficient contrast. This appears to be a color value error.
defects.location: Hero headline area, center-top of pricing section

defects.description: The 'Trusted by 10,000+ teams worldwide' text and partner logos (Stripe, Notion, Figma, Linear, Vercel) use the same illegible light color against white background, rendering them nearly invisible.
defects.location: Social proof section below pricing cards

defects.description: The billing toggle at bottom-left is partially clipped/cut off, showing only a rounded pill shape with 'Yearly' label and a green segment. It lacks clear 'Monthly' labeling and appears broken or unfinished.
Navigation bar contains 'Flowly' logo overlapping with 'Features' text ('FlowlyFeatures'), indicating poor text alignment or spacing in the header.
Feature lists in Starter and Enterprise tiers lack checkmark icons (only Pro has visible checkmarks), creating visual inconsistency and making scanability harder.
defects.location: Starter and Enterprise card feature lists

defects.description: The 'MOST POPULAR' badge on Pro tier uses a teal/green color that clashes slightly with the purple accent used elsewhere, and its positioning feels cramped against the tier name.
defects.location: Pro tier card, top-left badge area

missing_elements: Monthly/yearly billing toggle at the TOP of the page (currently misplaced at bottom)
Visible 'Monthly' label on the billing toggle
Checkmark icons for feature lists in Starter and Enterprise tiers
Proper contrast/color values for hero headline text
Proper contrast/color values for social proof section text and logos
top_fixes: Move the billing toggle to the top of the page, directly below the hero headline and above the pricing cards, with clear 'Monthly' and 'Yearly' labels and proper spacing
Fix the hero headline color to use a dark color (e.g., slate-900) with proper contrast against the white background instead of the current near-white invisible text
Add checkmark icons to the Starter and Enterprise feature lists for consistency with the Pro tier
Fix the navigation bar text overlap where 'Flowly' and 'Features' are colliding
Restore visibility to the social proof section by using appropriate dark text colors for the trust statement and partner logos
